projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
A new analytics dashboard project delivering three core capabilities: (1) data processing pipelines that ingest and normalize customer CSV files, (2) log analysis over application logs, and (3) visualization components that surface insights to end users. Structured into milestones with tasks sized to be individually executable.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: M1: Foundation & Architecture
tasks.details: Establish the technical foundation for the analytics dashboard: define architecture, set up the repository and environments, choose the data storage layer, and agree on shared data contracts. This milestone unblocks all three feature streams.

tasks.name: M2: Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details:
Build the ingestion and processing pipeline for customer CSV files: schema validation, parsing, cleaning/normalization, deduplication, and loading into the analytics store. Deliver a reliable, repeatable pipeline with error handling and monitoring.

CONTAINER MILESTONE: no direct implementation at this level. Execution is tracked in 5 child tasks (ingestion loader, schema validation, cleaning/normalization, deduplication, load+monitoring), each complexity ≤5.

tasks.name: M3: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details:
Build the log analysis capability: ingest application logs, parse structured and unstructured entries, extract metrics and error patterns, and produce aggregated analytics (error rates, latency, traffic) for the dashboard.

CONTAINER MILESTONE: no direct implementation at this level. Execution is tracked in 5 child tasks (ingestion/shipping, parser, error/metric extraction, aggregation queries, monitoring/retention), each complexity ≤5.

tasks.name: M4: Visualization Components
tasks.details:
Design and build the dashboard UI: reusable chart components, dashboard layout, filters, and data binding to the processing and log-analysis APIs. Ensure responsive, accessible, and performant rendering.

CONTAINER MILESTONE: no direct implementation at this level. Execution is tracked in 5 child tasks (UX design, chart library, filters, API binding, accessibility/responsive), each complexity ≤5.

tasks.name: M5: Integration, Testing & Launch
tasks.details: Integrate all three streams end-to-end, run performance and security testing, complete documentation, and deploy to production with monitoring and a rollback plan.

tasks.name: Define system architecture and data flow
tasks.details: Produce an architecture document covering the CSV pipeline, log pipeline, storage, API layer, and frontend. Include a data-flow diagram and identify key technology choices and trade-offs.

tasks.name: Set up repository, CI/CD, and environments
tasks.details: Create the monorepo/repo structure, branching strategy, CI pipeline (lint, test, build), and dev/staging/prod environments with secrets management.

tasks.name: Select and provision data storage layer
tasks.details: Evaluate and provision the analytics data store (e.g., warehouse + object storage for raw files). Set up schemas, access controls, and backup/retention policies.

tasks.name: Define shared data contracts and schemas
tasks.details: Document canonical schemas for customer records, log events, and aggregated metrics. Publish versioned contracts (e.g., JSON Schema/Protobuf) that all three streams consume.

tasks.name: Build CSV ingestion loader
tasks.details: Implement upload/ingest of customer CSV files (batch and scheduled), with file tracking, chunked reading, and raw-file archival to object storage.

tasks.name: Implement CSV schema validation and error reporting
tasks.details: Validate incoming CSVs against the canonical customer schema. Produce per-row error reports, quarantine invalid rows, and surface validation summaries to operators.

tasks.name: Implement cleaning and normalization rules
tasks.details: Apply type coercion, date/locale normalization, trimming, and field standardization. Make rules configurable and unit-tested.

tasks.name: Implement deduplication and customer identity resolution
tasks.details: Detect duplicate customer records across files using deterministic and fuzzy matching keys. Define merge/survivorship rules and record lineage.

tasks.name: Load processed data into analytics store with monitoring
tasks.details: Write cleaned records to the analytics store (upsert/idempotent loads), add pipeline metrics, alerting on failures, and a re-run/backfill mechanism.

tasks.name: Build log ingestion and shipping
tasks.details: Collect application logs from sources (files/agents/streams) into the log store. Handle rotation, backpressure, and at-least-once delivery.

tasks.name: Implement log parser for structured and unstructured entries
tasks.details: Parse JSON/structured logs and extract fields from unstructured text via regex/grok patterns. Normalize timestamps, severity, service, and request IDs into the canonical log-event schema.

tasks.name: Extract error patterns and key metrics
tasks.details: Classify errors/exceptions, cluster recurring patterns, and extract latency, status codes, and throughput fields needed for downstream aggregation.

tasks.name: Build aggregation queries for error rate, latency, and traffic
tasks.details: Create time-bucketed aggregation jobs/queries that produce dashboard-ready metrics (error rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, request volume) per service and time window.

tasks.name: Add log pipeline monitoring and retention policies
tasks.details: Instrument the log pipeline with health metrics and alerts, and configure retention/tiering to control storage cost and meet compliance requirements.

tasks.name: Design dashboard layout and UX
tasks.details: Create wireframes and a design spec for dashboard pages, navigation, KPI cards, and chart placement. Validate with stakeholders before build.

tasks.name: Build reusable chart component library
tasks.details: Implement reusable line, bar, pie, and table components with consistent theming, loading/empty/error states, and typed props.

tasks.name: Implement filters and date-range controls
tasks.details: Add global filters (date range, service, customer segment) with URL-synced state and debounced query updates.

tasks.name: Bind visualization components to data APIs
tasks.details: Wire chart components to the metrics/query APIs with caching, pagination, and graceful error handling.

tasks.name: Accessibility and responsive polish
tasks.details: Ensure WCAG AA contrast, keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, and responsive layouts across breakpoints. Add automated a11y checks to CI.

tasks.name: End-to-end integration testing
tasks.details: Test the full flow from CSV upload and log ingestion through aggregation to dashboard rendering. Automate critical-path E2E tests.

tasks.name: Performance and load testing
tasks.details: Benchmark pipeline throughput and dashboard query latency under realistic and peak loads. Identify and fix bottlenecks; define SLOs.

tasks.name: Security and access control review
tasks.details: Review authentication/authorization, PII handling in customer data, secrets management, and data-at-rest/in-transit encryption. Remediate findings.

tasks.name: Write documentation and runbooks
tasks.details: Document architecture, data contracts, pipeline operations, and incident runbooks. Include onboarding and troubleshooting guides.

tasks.name: Production deployment and monitoring
tasks.details: Deploy to production with blue/green or canary rollout, dashboards/alerts, and a documented rollback plan. Run a post-launch smoke test.
